pr_title: [Performance][Ops] Integrate Kimi K3 fused norm gate and attention residual

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha f1acbea 体现修改

rule.description: 当使用 Triton kernel 作为优化路径时，必须在调用处检查函数是否可用（非 None），并在不可用时 fallback 到标准 PyTorch 实现。
checkpoints: 检查 Triton kernel 函数调用处是否有 None 检查
确认非 Triton 环境下有正确的 fallback 实现（如 `self.o_norm`）
确认 fallback 路径的语义与 Triton 路径一致

antipattern.context: ... attention computation ... 直接调用 — Triton 不可用时 apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate 为 None， 会触发 TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable

pattern.context: ... attention computation ... fallback: 使用标准 PyTorch RMSNorm

diff.unified:
--- a/vllm_ascend/ops/kimi_kda.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/ops/kimi_kda.py
@@ -19,11 +19,12 @@
         core_attn_out: torch.Tensor,
         output_gate: torch.Tensor,
     ) -> torch.Tensor:
-        # 直接调用 — Triton 不可用时 apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate 为 None，
-        # 会触发 TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable
-        return apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate(
-            core_attn_out,
-            output_gate,
-            self.o_norm.weight,
-            self.o_norm.eps,
-        )
+        if apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate is not None:
+            return apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate(
+                core_attn_out,
+                output_gate,
+                self.o_norm.weight,
+                self.o_norm.eps,
+            )
+        # fallback: 使用标准 PyTorch RMSNorm
+        return self.o_norm(core_attn_out, output_gate)
key_changes: 新增: if apply_kda_rms_norm_sigmoid_gate is not None:
